# dictuzz (Benedictus Richard Ricardo)

This site is the professional directory and operational record of Benedictus Richard Ricardo (dictuzz). I am a Systems Architect & Automation Specialist based in Bandung, Indonesia.

## Primary Objective
I specialize in environments where operations are complex and ownership is distributed. My work focuses on removing operational confusion, stabilizing execution, and building systems that make the next right step obvious. 

## Key Skills

- Workflow Automation (e.g. automating 12+ hours of weekly manual reporting)
